title: The repository review manifest
description: One entry per file, recording where the file came from and who has read it. Facts only -- paths, enum values, names, dates, hashes -- and no free-form text. Whether a file's current version has been reviewed is not stored; it is derived by comparing hashes when the report is run.

path.description: Repository-relative path, as git reports it.

origin.description: How the file's content came to exist, insofar as it changes what reviewing the file means. A file a person writes is authored even where a tool fills parts of it in.

oneOf.title: authored
oneOf.description: Written deliberately, by a person or an agent, as prose or code.

oneOf.title: generated
oneOf.description: Produced by a tool from other inputs. Review the generator, not the output.

oneOf.title: framework
oneOf.description: Supplied by the REPRO framework or a project template and carried unmodified. Not this repository's to review.

generatedBy.description: Repository-relative path of what produces this file.

authoredBy.description: Who wrote it, where that is known. "unknown" means the record was never kept, not that nobody wrote it.

reviews.description: Every recorded human reading of this file, oldest first. Empty means no review has been recorded, which is not the same as nobody having read it.

review.title: One person having read one version of the file

by.description: The person who read it. A name, never a role and never an agent.

date.description: The date of the review, ISO 8601.

hash.description: The git blob hash of the content that was read, from `git hash-object <file>`. The current version has been reviewed exactly when its hash appears here.
